title_en: Psychology Made Simple (7/20): Three Ages, Three Ways to Play
note_en: 随着年龄的增长 "as children grow older" uses 随着 to introduce a change that drives another change: 随着 + noun phrase, then the main clause, often with 也 or 会. English uses a full clause with "as," but Chinese turns the process into a noun (年龄的增长 "the growth of age"), as again in 只是随着年龄增长，各种形式出现的比例会发生变化.
